prompt_md: A 30-day month begins on a Monday. How many Mondays are in that month?
prompt_short: A 30-day month starts on a Monday. How many Mondays?
explain_intuition_md: The Mondays fall on the 1st, 8th, 15th, 22nd and 29th. Four is the usual count, but a month that starts on a Monday squeezes in a fifth.
